atoms.text: The following level contains pictures of blood. If you do not want to see these, we would recommend skipping this lesson.

instruction.text: You have got a small cut on your hand. How should you treat the wound?

b: Run your hand under hot water, then leave it.
++Let the wound stop bleeding, then run it under cold water and put a plaster on it.

instruction.text: What should you do if you have a nosebleed?

b: Tilt your head back and pinch your nose until the bleeding stops.
++Stay upright or seated with your head facing forwards, put a tissue in your nose and place a cold flannel on your neck.

feedback.end: If you have a nosebleed, you should not tilt your head backwards. This can cause the blood to run backwards into your stomach and cause nausea.

instruction.text: You have burnt yourself on the oven. What should you do as quickly as possible?

feedback.end: All small burns should immediately be run under cold or lukewarm water.

instruction.text: Larger burns should be treated with a sterile dressing. Which items would you use to treat a larger burn?

text: Correct. Each dressing pad is packaged separately and is sterile, meaning they don’t have any harmful germs on them.
Plastic gloves and scissors may also be useful.
end.sound: Correct. Each dressing pad is packaged separately and is sterile, meaning they don’t have any harmful germs on them. Plastic gloves and scissors may also be useful.

instruction.text: How should each injury be treated? Select the correct treatment for each injury.

text: First aid is only for small injuries. In the event of a serious injury, you should phone the emergency services.

atoms.b: Keep your head in its normal position and put a tissue in your nose.
Allow to dry, then wash with cold water or an anti-bacterial treatment. Finally, cover with a plaster.
Run under cold or lukewarm water immediately.
